projects.convince: This folder contains applications that allow R1 to dialog with users in the CONVINCE project Use Case 3. For more information about the project, please refer to the [UC3 repository](https://github.com/convince-project/UC3).

applications.convince_new_dialog_VAD_robot: Starts the convince dialog pipeline with VAD for execution on the robot.
applications.convince_new_dialog_VAD_test: Starts the convince dialog pipeline with VAD for execution in simulation.
applications.convince_new_dialog_test: Starts the convince dialog pipeline for execution in simulation.

modules.yarprobotinterface --context speechPipel: Starts the speech pipeline with microphone input.
modules.sileroVAD: Voice Activity Detection using Silero models.
modules.yarprobotinterface --context convince --: Starts the convince module with madamaChat configuration.
Starts the convince module with poiMadamaChat configuration.
Starts the convince module with welcomeTalkChat configuration.
modules.yarprobotinterface --context speechPipel: Starts the speech pipeline with Azure synthesizer.
Starts the speech pipeline with Azure transcription.
modules.ros2_speech_to_text_component run speech: Runs the ROS2 speech to text component.
modules.ros2_text_to_speech_component run text_t: Runs the ROS2 text to speech component.
modules.ros2_cpp_dance_component run dance_compo: Runs the ROS2 C++ dance component.
modules.ros2_execute_dance_component run execute: Runs the ROS2 execute dance component.
modules.ros2_cpp_dialog_component run dialog_com: Runs the ROS2 C++ dialog component.
modules.ros2_py_dialog_component run py_interact: Runs the ROS2 Python dialog component.
modules.ros2_dialog_skill run dialog_skill dialo: Runs the ROS2 dialog skill component.
